subject.title: refactor: canonicalize correctness-critical UI and channel contracts

question: Should this maintainer-owned umbrella remain the canonical tracker while the linked Workboard and channel-status PRs are reviewed, or should maintainers split the remaining Control UI gateway work into narrower issues now?
rationale: The issue is protected by the maintainer label and spans security-sensitive status output plus package/protocol ownership boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent tracking and API shape.

options.title: Keep umbrella through staged PRs
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical coordination point until the open Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then drive the remaining Control UI gateway slice here.

options.title: Split remaining gateway work
options.body: Create narrower maintainer-owned issues for the remaining Control UI gateway contract work and close this umbrella only after all linked context is preserved there.

options.title: Pause pending PR outcomes
options.body: Keep this issue open without new work-lane activity until maintainers decide whether the two open PRs establish the right seams.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella through staged PRs
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical coordination point until the open Workboard and channel-status PRs land or are rejected, then drive the remaining Control UI gateway slice here.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the umbrella issue, is assigned to it, and authored the currently open implementation-candidate PRs.
